## History

Elder Abraham served as the Superintendent of the [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school), a role he held for fourteen years during which he was noted for never smiling. His community was thrown into a scandal when the Meredith children mistakenly cleaned their house and shook rugs in the graveyard on a Sunday. [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) subsequently devised a plan to address the misunderstanding caused within Elder Abraham's town.
